title: Instacart reportedly discussed selling itself with DoorDash and Uber
summary: Instacart might sell itself to a larger competitor.
llm_summary: Instacart has reportedly entered talks with rival delivery platforms DoorDash and Uber about a possible acquisition, sparking speculation that the grocery‑delivery startup could be sold to a larger competitor. Sources say the discussions are in early stages, with both DoorDash and Uber assessing whether buying Instacart would strengthen their own logistics and grocery‑shopping offerings. If a deal goes through, it would mark a major shake‑up in the on‑demand
